# Local OCR assets

Tesseract.js 7.0.0 with matching tesseract.js-core (LSTM builds only).
Vietnamese and English traineddata: @tesseract.js-data/vie and eng 1.0.0,
4.0.0_best_int models. Apache-2.0 upstream projects; bundled license notices.

All assets served from this application. No CDN or remote OCR endpoint.
Models are loaded only after user consent; traineddata cached in IndexedDB.
This engine is a printed-text baseline, not a guarantee for handwriting.
